question: Find Mohan Kulkarni's dependents.
sql: SELECT fi.name, fi.relationship, fi.date_of_birth FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN pers.family_info fi ON em.user_id = fi.user_id WHERE em.name ILIKE '%Mohan Kulkarni%' AND fi.is_currently_dependent = true

question: List the family members of an employee.
sql: SELECT fi.name, fi.relationship, fi.date_of_birth FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN pers.family_info fi ON em.user_id = fi.user_id WHERE em.user_id ILIKE 'EMP00326'

question: List the trainings of an employee.
sql: SELECT utm.course_name, utm.grade_obtain, utm.certificate_issue_date FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN training.user_training_mapping utm ON em.elan = utm.elan WHERE em.user_id ILIKE 'EMP00326'

question: Which trainings are going on currently?
sql: SELECT course_name, start_date, end_date FROM training.training_master WHERE start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY end_date

question: Which trainings are upcoming?
sql: SELECT course_name, start_date, end_date FROM training.training_master WHERE start_date > CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY start_date

question: Show the email and contact of a person.
sql: SELECT c.contact_category, c.value FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN pers.contact c ON em.user_id = c.user_id WHERE em.name ILIKE '%Mohan Kulkarni%'

question: List the top 5 centres by number of employees.
sql: SELECT cm.centre_name, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN utility.centre_master cm ON em.current_centre_alias = cm.centre_alias GROUP BY cm.centre_name ORDER BY employee_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Give me the names of all employees in a team or centre.
sql: SELECT em.name FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN utility.centre_master cm ON em.current_centre_alias = cm.centre_alias WHERE cm.centre_alias ILIKE '%CFR%' OR cm.centre_name ILIKE '%CFR%'

question: List the 5 most recently joined employees with name and designation.
sql: SELECT name, current_designation FROM pers.employee_master ORDER BY date_of_joining_org DESC LIMIT 5

question: List signers and how many documents they signed.
sql: SELECT sg.name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.document_id) AS documents_signed FROM digitalsig.signers sg JOIN digitalsig.signatures s ON sg.id = s.signer_id GROUP BY sg.name ORDER BY documents_signed DESC

question: Did a person book any guest house?
sql: SELECT gh.guest_house_name, gb.booking_type, gb.check_in_date, gb.check_out_date, gb.status FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN request.guest_house_booking gb ON em.user_id = gb.employee_id JOIN request.guest_house gh ON gh.guest_house_id = gb.guest_house_id WHERE em.name ILIKE '%Gayatri Das%'

question: List the awards received by an employee.
sql: SELECT a.* FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN pers.awards a ON em.user_id = a.user_id WHERE em.name ILIKE '%Mohan Kulkarni%'

question: Show the education records of an employee.
sql: SELECT e.* FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN pers.education e ON em.user_id = e.user_id WHERE em.name ILIKE '%Mohan Kulkarni%'

question: Show the promotion history of an employee.
sql: SELECT p.* FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN pers.promotion p ON em.user_id = p.user_id WHERE em.user_id ILIKE 'EMP00326' ORDER BY p.id

question: Count employees grouped by a column.
sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM pers.employee_master GROUP BY gender

question: How many active employees are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pers.employee_master WHERE is_active = true

question: How many employees are in each cadre?
sql:
SELECT current_cadre, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM pers.employee_master GROUP BY current_cadre ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 500

question: how may employee join in 2025 and 26
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN pers.posting p ON em.user_id = p.user_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.joining_date) IN (2025, 2026)
LIMIT 500

question: how may employee join in 2025 and 26 give details of this employee
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count, em.name, em.date_of_joining_org FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN pers.posting p ON em.user_id = p.user_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.joining_date) IN (2025, 2026) GROUP BY em.name, em.date_of_joining_org
LIMIT 500

question: Names that are nominated in an active or inactive committee
sql: SELECT DISTINCT em.name FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN request.committee rc ON em.user_id = rc.user_id WHERE rc.is_active IN (true, false) ORDER BY em.name

question: List employees nominated in active committees
sql: SELECT DISTINCT em.name, rc.committee_name FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN request.committee rc ON em.user_id = rc.user_id WHERE rc.is_active = true

question: Show all committee nominations with status
sql: SELECT em.name, rc.committee_name, rc.status, rc.is_active, rc.nominated_by FROM pers.employee_master em JOIN request.committee rc ON em.user_id = rc.user_id ORDER BY em.name
